summary: Closure review: the authors have not resolved the prior required manuscript-level fixes. Run-level provenance (file paths and full artifact hashes) remains in the Disclosure Statement and in Methods/Results prose, and the manuscript still contains raw DOI/URL/run-path strings instead of standard IEEE-numbered citations. These issues must be fixed before finalisation. Scientific preregistration, execution, and analysis artifacts appear complete and consistent in the archive; no new experiments are required.
critical_issues: Disclosure Statement contains run-internal file paths and full artifact hashes in prose rather than a concise high-level disclosure and a single IEEE-numbered citation to the archived execution manifest.

Methods and Results (and figure/table captions) still include explicit run-internal artifact paths and filenames (e.g., execution/task_manifest.jsonl, execution/responses/...) instead of citing the archived execution_manifest with an IEEE-numbered reference.

Manuscript prose contains raw DOI/URL/run-path occurrences rather than standard IEEE numeric citations; some cited records are presented as URLs/DOIs in-line rather than as numbered references supporting the adjacent scholarly claims.
required_revisions: Condense the Disclosure Statement to the mandatory high-level elements only (models used, orchestration adapter, autonomy-lock boundary, protocol deviations, artifact-availability statement). Remove per-file paths and full hashes from the manuscript body and Disclosure; replace with a single IEEE-numbered citation pointing to the archived execution manifest (the archive provides the full hash manifest).

Replace all run-internal file paths and artifact filenames appearing in Methods, Results, figure/table captions, and the Disclosure with IEEE-numbered citations referencing the archived execution manifest or artifact bundle. Do not place ordinary run-level paths or full hashes in the manuscript body; retain full provenance in the archived artifact bundle referenced by the citation.

Convert any remaining raw DOI/URL occurrences in narrative prose to standard IEEE numeric citations and verify that each cited bibliographic record explicitly supports the nearby claim; fix any citation–claim mismatches so that each in-text citation points to a referenced work that actually supports the statement. Ensure references in the bibliography use standard IEEE formatting.
optional_revisions: Add a brief paragraph in Discussion clarifying practical significance given the ceiling effect (guarded=100%) and small discordant count (n10=6) to aid operational interpretation beyond statistical detectability.

Provide a short high-level table (or point to an archived table) enumerating the six discordant pairs with simple diagnostic labels (sanitizer-only vs repair-applied); keep detailed traces in the archive rather than in the paper.

In Methods and in the Disclosure, explicitly recommend the provider sampling parameter for deterministic reproduction (e.g., temperature = 0) and cite the execution manifest where the current unset temperature is recorded.
